title: 1941 FBI vetting of Silas Newton

tellings.quote: A document from July 1st, 1941 mentions, he appears to be a good American citizen, has no accent in his speech,

plain: A government file from July 1, 1941 vouched for Silas Newton, a man tied to the story of a flying saucer said to have crashed at Aztec, New Mexico. The file is from the FBI, the US federal police agency, and it says he "appears to be a good American citizen, has no accent in his speech." Michels reads this from the FBI files, alongside a book called It Came to Earth at Aztec and the work of the researchers Scott Ramsey and Suzanne Ramsey, as something that bears on whether Newton can be believed.
